charts.title: TOI-4507 b: orbits around TOI-4507
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4507's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4507 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Rea et al. 2026 (2026A&A...711A..86R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname REA_ET_AL_2026): P 104.616063 d

charts.title: TOI-4507 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4507 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 97, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 179582003, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 37-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 37-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
